label: CHANGE_2: Changes x: x changes in some characteristic, quality or relation, the thoughts of…
definition: `Changes x`: x changes in some characteristic, quality or relation, the thoughts of conscious beings included. This is McTaggart's general notion of change, of which he argues that it can only be A-series change (STMT-MCTAGGART-ALL-CHANGE-IS-A-SERIES-CHANGE). It is a Lean parameter. It is neither A-series change (DEF-A-SERIES-CHANGE) nor reduction from potency to act (DEF-MOTION-AS-REDUCTION); that every reduction from potency to act is a change in this sense is the separate open bridge STMT-MOTION-IS-A-CHANGE.
